test_title: PYST 04: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

"The editor has approved the final version."

options.text: The final version has been approved by the editor.
The final version was approved by the editor.
The final version was being approved.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The editor has approved the final version."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the final version" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "has approved" to "has been approved" (present perfect passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the editor."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The final version has been approved by the editor."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"The final version was approved by the editor." – Incorrect tense (past simple passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"The final version was being approved." – Incorrect tense (past continuous passive).
 
• **Option 4: **"The final version is approved." – Incorrect tense (present simple passive).
